Mass Torts Made Perfect Seminar is one of the largest gatherings of plaintiff mass tort attorneys in the nation. The Las Vegas conference is taking place October 22-24, 2019.

MTMP is designed to maximize your ability to network and build relationships, learn strategy, and gain insight into the latest mass torts. If you are looking to grow your law firm in this arena, this conference might be beneficial.

Here are five reasons you should check it out.

1. Learn the Biggest Mass Torts Right Now

As a gathering point for the promotion of mass torts litigation, MTMP covers all of the big mass tort topics right now. List them?

2. Speakers

3. Networking Opportunities

4. You Get to Connect with Us!

Okay, we’re a little biased on this one, but we can’t wait to meet you!

At Alert, we are passionate about helping law firms, and we specialize in mass tort services. We understand that incoming calls and web leads are hard to manage around the clock without an effective intake system in place, especially during large-scale campaigns.

Stop by our booth (#21 on Wednesday and #49 on Thursday and Friday) to learn more about how we can help your law firm crush your next big mass tort campaign and maximize your ROI. We’d be happy to answer any questions you might have about our services.

For the second year, we are sponsoring the charging station, so you can keep your laptops and phones charged throughout the event. Be sure to check it out!
